packs.title: Studios, Markets and Waterways
packs.promise: Explore Detroit through separate maker, market, neighborhood and island outings.

q.s: Keep the artwork and its display distinct.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Choose one collection work in an open gallery or the DIA digital guide.
Record a visible material detail and a separate fact from its label; do not infer a date from appearance.

q.s: Look at a changing market without buying.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
During an open market or from its official vendor information, find three materials or produce types from different stalls.
Record how each is displayed or packaged; no purchase, tasting or vendor conversation is required.

q.s: Notice how craft changes a surface.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Choose a tile or ceramic from an open public area or Pewabic’s official virtual tour.
Sketch one shape and describe how glaze changes the way light meets it; do not touch displayed work.

packs.title: Downtown to Riverfront
packs.promise: Walk from downtown civic spaces to connected riverfront parks.

q.s: Map a public park before moving on.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From an open park path or Downtown Detroit Partnership map, identify a garden or fountain and an adjacent crossing.
Record how the park meets the surrounding entertainment streets without stepping into traffic.

q.s: Notice how one space supports many uses.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From an open path or park operator map, identify two ways people can move around the square.
Choose a safe onward crossing toward Griswold Street; no seasonal rink, beach or event is required.

q.s: Describe sculpture without speaking for a city.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From the open plaza or city image, identify the figure and two forms held by its hands.
Separate what you can see from the official city explanation of the public plaza.
